Windows error guide / Code 10

Code 10Microsoft

Device start failure

Context

The device did not start; this alone does not prove hardware damage.

Checks

  1. Record the full device status and driver version in Properties.
  2. Compare recent driver changes with the version offered by the manufacturer.

Next action

Check the linked Microsoft code guidance; if unresolved, give the observations to the maker’s official support.

Sources

  • Microsoft Learn ↗
  • Microsoft Support ↗
